titulo.alumno: An ending · Telling events in order

intro: Part 3: an ending. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: A narrative organises events with «først», «bagefter» and «til sidst». Check what happened before and what changed afterwards; the order of the sentences does not always match the time order.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.estudio: Til sidst fandt de den rigtige adresse.
frases.alumno: In the end they found the right address.

frases.estudio: Derfor nåede de mødet til tiden.
frases.alumno: That is why they reached the meeting on time.
